title: Photo Album for Girlfriend: A Gift With Your Story in It | Albums.ink
desc: Photo album for your girlfriend: what to include, captions, voice notes and a private link she can open on her phone. Free, no ads.
h1: Photo album for your girlfriend: a birthday or anniversary gift with your story in it
lead: Most searches for a “photo album for girlfriend” in the UK end at a printed photo book or a mini album. They are lovely, but they cannot hold the video from your first trip to Edinburgh or your voice explaining why that rainy day in Brighton still makes you laugh. An online story album can. Here is how to make one she will want to open again.
body: ## What to put in a photo album for your girlfriend
- The beginning: the first photo of the two of you, a copy of the first message, the place you first met.
- Trips and weekends: a city break, a cottage in the Lakes, the pub quiz you nearly won.
- Little things: her coffee order, the film you always rewatch, the dog you both stop for.
- Her people: friends and family who have become yours too.
- What comes next: a last chapter with plans — a trip, a gig, a new flat.
- One caption per photo: one line is enough. Inside jokes count.
## Build it as a free story album

On Albums you create a story album with chapters, photos, videos and voice notes. Add narration and play it back as a slideshow. To share it, add her as a friend and choose Friends — that includes all your friends, so to show it only to her choose Friends, except… and exclude the others. Check the setting again after you add new friends. Only me does not give access through a link. No ads. The album stays as long as you want it.
1. Create a free album — e.g. “Two years of us”.
2. Add chapters: How it started, Our trips, Everyday us, Next.
3. Upload photos (up to 30 MB each, up to 2048 px on the long edge on the free plan) and short videos (up to 50 MB).
4. Record a voice note in the browser or upload audio (up to 20 MB) — read a message aloud instead of writing it.
5. Want her best friend to add a chapter? Invite one co-author who is already your friend on Albums.
More ideas: private photo sharing for couples and anniversary photo album ideas.

Play the slideshow with your narration over dinner, or send her the link with the card. She opens it in the browser on her phone or laptop and signs in with Google. You can also download the whole album as one ZIP to keep a copy.

faq: What should I put in a photo album for my girlfriend?
Your first photo together, trips, everyday moments, her friends and family, and a last chapter with plans — one caption per photo.
Can I make a photo album for my girlfriend for free?
Yes. A story album on Albums is free, with chapters, photos, videos and voice notes. No ads.
How do I make sure only she can see it?
Add her as a friend, choose Friends, except… and exclude everyone else. Check again after you add new friends.
Can I add a voice message?
Yes. Record a voice note in the browser or upload an audio file up to 20 MB.
